method.selection: name-matched, then confirmed against mfapi's own scheme_category; up to 3 schemes from 3 different fund houses per category
method.cagr: point-to-point on NAV, anniversary matched within 20 days
method.volatility_annualised: stdev of daily log returns over 3y * sqrt(252)
method.aggregation: median across the accepted schemes per category
